test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The conservator repaired the **fillet** on the old manuscript binding.

options.text: The chef pan-seared a salmon fillet with herbs.
The bookbinder stitched the leather fillet tightly.
The fillet was traced in gold on the spine.
The medieval fillet indicated title divisions.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "The chef pan-seared a salmon fillet with herbs."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fillet"** in the context of the sentence refers to a thin strip or band, often used in bookbinding or manuscripts. (पट्टी या पतली धारी)
 
 
• **Example:** The conservator repaired the decorative fillet on the manuscript binding.
 
 
 
• The homonym **"fillet"** (used in Option 1) refers to a boneless cut of fish or meat, typically prepared for cooking. (मछली या मांस का बिन हड्डी का टुकड़ा)
 
 
• **Example:** The chef prepared a delicious salmon fillet for dinner.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct homonym of "fillet" in the context of the provided sentence is the one mentioned in Option 1.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** The bookbinder stitched the leather fillet tightly. (पुस्तक बाइंडर ने चमड़े की पट्टी को कसकर सिल दिया।)
 
 
• This refers to a decorative band or strip used in bookbinding, matching the meaning in the original sentence. It does not represent a homonym.
 
 

 
• **Option 3:** The fillet was traced in gold on the spine. (फिलेट को किताब की रीढ़ पर सोने से अंकित किया गया।)
 
 
• This also refers to a decorative element in bookbinding, not a homonym.
 
 

 
• **Option 4:** The medieval fillet indicated title divisions. (मध्ययुगीन फिलेट ने शीर्षक विभाजन को दर्शाया।)
 
 
• This refers to a decorative or functional strip used in manuscripts or books, which is similar in meaning to the original sentence.
 
 

177:Te23,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
